from cyclopts import App
from cyclopts.types import ExistingPath

app = App()

@app.command
def convert(input_file: ExistingPath, output_name: str) -> None:
    """Convert an existing file to a new output name."""
    print(f"Converting {input_file} to {output_name}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app()
